about.title: Meet Tammy Holliday
about.paragraph1: Tammy Holliday Photography has been serving the Gauteng community for years, building a strong portfolio with hundreds of satisfied clients across weddings, families, and portrait sessions. Every shoot is a chance to tell a story — your story.
about.paragraph2: Based in Gauteng, Tammy brings a personal, relaxed approach to every session. Whether it's the quiet intimacy of a newborn shoot or the joyful chaos of a family gathering, she captures the real moments that matter most.
about.paragraph3: With a passion for timeless imagery and a commitment to making every client feel at ease, Tammy Holliday Photography is your trusted partner for life's most important milestones.

pageContent.servicesDescription: From weddings to newborn sessions, I offer a range of photography services tailored to capture your most meaningful moments across Gauteng.
pageContent.servicesCtaText: Let's create something beautiful together. Get in touch to discuss your vision and check availability for your date.
pageContent.contactDescription: I'd love to hear about your photography needs. Whether you're planning a wedding, expecting a new arrival, or want to capture family memories, let's talk.
pageContent.portfolioDescription: Browse through my collection of work spanning weddings, families, newborns, couples, portraits, and more across Gauteng.
pageContent.gallerySubtitle: Explore my work across different photography styles — from intimate weddings to joyful family sessions.
pageContent.aboutSubtitle: The photographer behind the lens, passionate about capturing life's most beautiful moments.

services.title: Wedding Photography
services.description: Comprehensive coverage of your special day, capturing every emotion and detail from preparation to reception. I document the laughter, tears, and joy that make your wedding uniquely yours.

services.title: Family & Portrait Sessions
services.description: Fun, relaxed sessions for families, couples, and individuals, creating timeless portraits in studio or on location across Gauteng. No stiff poses — just real moments.

services.title: Newborn & Maternity
services.description: Gentle, safe, and beautiful sessions to welcome your new arrival or celebrate the journey of pregnancy. These early moments pass so quickly — let's preserve them.

services.title: Matric & Cake Smash
services.description: Celebrating life's milestones with creative and joyful photography sessions. From matric dance elegance to messy cake smash fun, every milestone deserves to be remembered.

services.title: Events
services.description: Professional coverage for your special events, ensuring no moment is missed. Corporate functions, birthday parties, and celebrations of all kinds.

faq.question: How do I book a session?
faq.answer: Simply call Tammy at 083 479 9732 or email letsmeet@tammyholliday.co.za to discuss your needs and schedule a date. A deposit secures your booking.

faq.question: What is the turnaround time for photos?
faq.answer: Editing and delivery times vary by service, but Tammy will provide a clear timeline during your consultation. Typically, portrait sessions are delivered within 2-3 weeks, and weddings within 4-6 weeks.

faq.question: What should we wear for our portrait session?
faq.answer: Tammy will provide a style guide and advice to help you coordinate outfits that look great on camera. Generally, neutral tones and soft colours photograph beautifully.

faq.question: Do you travel for shoots?
faq.answer: Yes! Tammy is based in Gauteng and covers areas including Sandton, Centurion, Midrand, Pretoria, Benoni, Kempton Park, Edenvale, and surrounding suburbs. Travel fees may apply for locations outside the greater Gauteng area.

faq.question: Can we get prints and albums?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Layflat albums start from R2,100 and come with a range of cover options. Tammy will walk you through all the available products during your consultation.

faq.question: How many photos will we receive?
faq.answer: The number of edited photos depends on the session type and duration. Portrait sessions typically deliver 30-50 images, while weddings can range from 300-800+ images.
